**Public draft**

I’m continuing the experiment. The question I want to answer is whether the workflow makes a difference compared with a baseline.

The workflow and its matched baseline each passed all three checks. Those checks showed no difference, so they don’t support a claim that the workflow improved performance. The public draft omits the private record and its contents.
